# ffmpeg.deltadelta.dev

> A free, private video converter that runs entirely in the web browser. It uses FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly, so files never leave the user's device.

The site is for people who want to convert a video without installing software or uploading files. The user drops a video on the page, picks an output format (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, GIF, MP3, WAV or M4A) and downloads the result. An "Advanced settings" panel adjusts quality, frame rate, trim, dimensions, colour model, audio channels and bitrate, encoding speed and rotation. The panel also shows the equivalent `ffmpeg` command, so the user can run the same conversion with FFmpeg on their own computer. The site is static: there is no server, account or upload. The FFmpeg WebAssembly core is downloaded once from the jsDelivr CDN.

## Pages

- [Video converter](https://ffmpeg.deltadelta.dev/): The single page of the site, with the converter and the advanced settings

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/delta1513/ffmpeg.deltadelta.dev): Source code (Next.js static export served by a Cloudflare Worker)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/delta1513/ffmpeg.deltadelta.dev/main/README.md): How the site works and how to run it locally

## Optional

- [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/): The media toolkit that does the conversion
- [ffmpeg.wasm](https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm): FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly
